painPoints: You do not want to think each time about which exercises to do.
You want to see your progress in numbers.
You need a clear system that is easy to fit into life.

coach.bio1: A personal trainer and IFBB Bikini athlete.
coach.bio2: I created YS FITNESS to give you not just a set of exercises, but a clear system you can train with independently and see your progress.
coach.bio3: My approach is training with logic, discipline without extremes, and work toward a real result.

items.q: Will the program suit a beginner?
items.a: Yes. The program adapts to your training level during the questionnaire. Exercises come with detailed explanations.

items.q: Can I train in a gym?
items.a: Yes, the program is designed for gym training with free weights and machines.
In Version 1 the program is formed from the questionnaire results. Editing will be added in later versions.

items.q: How are calories and macros calculated?
items.a: Based on your age, height, weight, and goal. The calculation is done automatically during registration.

items.q: What happens after the subscription ends?
items.a: Access to the personal cabinet and progress data will stop. You can renew the subscription at any time.

items.q: What is the difference between the 1- and 3-month plans?
items.a: The features are the same. The difference is duration and price. The 3-month plan is 480 ₴ more advantageous.
